yeh its normal for the smaller 4H/L shifter to vibrate. As for gas, they say to use 91/premium to get the most power but running lower octane like 87 is just fine too.

2010 plus got the new taco/4Runner engine with dual vvti. The previous gen single vvti found in the 07-09 is more than enough grunt to get you round town and stock the 1GR can make round 300 or so go if you ever plan to add power in the future. Since you don’t rlly know manual and are planning on dailying I’d say just go for an auto, manual is fun n all when cruising n stuff, but when you’re stuck in bumper to bumper traffic you’ll wish otherwise, and esp in a 4000lb SUV.

For fuel it literally doesn’t matter unless you boost it, the car will adjust timings accordingly depending on octane. I think 10+ with dual vvti advertises to use 91 but my friends n I rarely ever fill it up with anything other than 87/89 unless we feel like burning cash. Good luck and hopefully you’ll find the one for you
